8.4.3.2 ClearDtcNotification
[SWS_Dem_91002] Definition of configurable interface <Module>_ClearDtcNoti-
fication ⌈
Service Name
<Module>_ClearDtcNotification
Syntax
Std_ReturnType <Module>_ClearDtcNotification (
uint32 DTC,
Dem_DTCFormatType DTCFormat,
Dem_DTCOriginType DTCOrigin
)
Sync/Async
Asynchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
DTC
DTC or group of DTC that is cleared.
DTCFormat
Format of the DTC value.
Parameters (in)
DTCOrigin
Event memory which is selected by the current clear operation.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK is always returned
Description
Called by the Dem when performing a clear DTC operation.
Available via
Dem_Externals.h
⌋
